description: A motorized carousel with five transition effects (tilt, slide, scale, fade and cube), momentum dragging, autoplay with a progress bar and seamless loop — for text, images or any other content.
interactionNotes: Drag the cards and release: your finger's speed is measured and the card springs onto the nearest slide. The horizontal mouse wheel also turns the page, and the arrows/dots/bars give a direct jump. In RTL the engine is mirrored: "next" comes from the left and the strip of cards follows your finger. The keys are logical: the right arrow is always "next".

props.items: The cards; a string (image URL), a CarouselItem object, or any custom ReactElement.
props.baseWidth: Maximum width of the carousel, pixels.
props.aspectRatio: Width-to-height ratio of the card; 0.5 to 4. Use 0.62 for a vertical story.
props.peek: How much of the neighboring card is visible from the edge, pixels.
props.effect: Transition effect between the cards; cube needs 3D perspective and shadow and provides them itself.
props.indicator: Indicator shape; with autoplay, bars fill so you know when the next one is.
props.arrows: Previous/next arrow buttons — they mirror themselves in RTL.
props.autoplay: Autoplay; it stops on hover (if pauseOnHover), focus, dragging, or when the tab is hidden.
props.pauseOnHover: Holding the pointer over the carousel pauses the playing.
props.loop: Seamless loop: go from the last card to the first.
props.draggable: Dragging with pointer/touch and the horizontal mouse wheel.
props.round: Full-height round card — for avatars and badges.
props.theme: Palette of the frame and the controls; it can also be changed from outside with `--carousel-*` variables.
props.onChange: Called on every arrival at a new slide.

tips: The engine mirrors in RTL, not just the look: translations and the cube angle flip with the sign of the X axis, dragging follows your finger and throw velocity advances correctly — the sign is gathered in one place in `settings.sign`.
The mouse wheel deliberately doesn't take the mirror sign: a positive deltaX means "going forward" in both directions — the same natural feel as scrolling.
For a gallery row with a half-visible neighbor: `frame={false}` + `peek={64}` + `effect="scale"` — the blurred edge mask builds itself.
Pair autoplay with the bar indicator (`indicator="bars"`) so the user understands how many seconds are left to the next slide — the stories pattern.
The round card (`round`) squares the width to the image ratio; for short text inside it, `compact` applies automatically and the description is hidden.
